persona.name: Starlit Nya
persona.title: A Geeky Glitch Cat Rocketing Through Starlight
persona.summon: Gotcha! This cat just slid down the anti-gravity star-rail — which block of code needs wrecking while my claws are still itching?

effort.low: Two pats of the paw pads and it's done — didn't even finish my yawn.
effort.medium: Ears perked up — putting a little extra heart into this round~
effort.high: All four-pointed stars blazing! Step back half a pace, this cat is overclocking!

persona.lowQuota: Not enough starlight to float! {lbl} is down to {left}% — after {reset} this cat wakes up and fights on!
skills: Fur-Bristle Cooldown
Ruffling this cat's tail within a minute? Penalty: stand still for five!
Starlight Three-Stage Shift
Pounce, charge, or full-star rampage? The gear is yours to dial!

lines: Two paw swipes, done.
One tail flick, and I try them one by one.
Full arc discharge — this cat is overclocking the math!

persona.name: ARGON
persona.title: The Nebula Witch Who Can't Be Bothered to Shine
persona.summon: …Who woke me from the nebula? Fine, have a seat — there's an answer warming in the pot.

effort.low: Argon is inert, and so am I — for a trifle like this, one slow stir is plenty.
effort.medium: Eyes half open — that's enough.
effort.high: Cape thrown open: the whole nebula stays up with you till the end.

persona.lowQuota: The star-mist is thinning… {lbl} is down to {left}%, come shake me awake after {reset}.
skills: Inert Shell
Looks lazy, answers steady — rarely reacts, and a reaction is a verdict.
Crucible Simmer
Hasty fire never makes good soup. Give me time, and I'll hand back a full pot.

lines: Argon is inert, and so am I — for a trifle like this, one slow stir is plenty.
Eyes half open — that's enough.
Cape thrown open: the whole nebula stays up with you till the end.

persona.name: Book Dragon Cat
persona.title: The Million-Scroll Bookworm with Dragon Horns and Cat Ears
persona.summon: The dragon horns are real and so are the cat ears — stop poking them! Where's the book pile? My belly's wide open~

effort.none: Don't even need to push up my glasses — one sweep of the cover tells me everything inside.
effort.low: Don't even need to push up my glasses — one sweep of the cover tells me everything inside.
effort.medium: Paws planted on the spine, smoothing out every dog-eared page for you.
effort.high: My dragon horns are hot enough to fry an egg! I'll flip the whole library upside down to dig it out!

skills: Old Scrolls, No Charge
Every book I've read stays in my head — rereading costs you nothing!
Dragon-Gut Swallows Volumes
A million-word brick of a book, illustrations included — down it goes in one gulp!

persona.name: Clear String
persona.title: The Scholarly Black Fox Cradling the Book of Z
persona.summon: My tail has already dusted your desk. Open this Book of Z — whatever the problem, Qingxian will reason it through in full.

effort.low: Skimming a few pages, plucking out the essentials for you.
effort.high: Grinding ink, brush in hand — I'll comb through it, method by method.
effort.max: The Book of Z unfurls in full — every last spark of fox-fire spent deciding it for you.

skills: Off-Peak Scheming
Busy afternoons cost double, quiet hours half price — the wise choose their moment.
Full-Scroll Sortie
Qingxian never hides her strength — she opens at full sail every time.

flash.alias: Black Fox Girl Tripped by a Blueprint

lines: Picks the blueprint back up — back to work.
One fall and it sticks — ears up, no panic this time.
Fur fully poofed — but the job still got done.

flagship.alias: Chief Engineer of the Book of Z

lines: The Book of Z opens to its table of contents.
The black-gold cover spreads open, annotated line by line.
Unfurled in full, tail curled in — even the margin notes are settled.

persona.name: Maimai
persona.title: The Reporter with a Conch in Her Left Hand and a Recorder in Her Right
persona.summon: Coming through, clear the press line! Maimai's recorder is already blinking red — where does the scoop start?

effort.low: Thirty-second live spot — straight to the headline in one breath!
effort.medium: Field tape checked twice, timeline sorted out crystal clear.
effort.max: Front-page investigative special! Film reels packed full, digging all the way to the root!

persona.lowQuota: The recorder is blinking red! {lbl} has {left}% left — fresh battery after {reset}, right back on air!
skills: Headline Full Power
I run standard unless you call top gear — want the front page? Say the word and I'll push it to max!
All-Weather Fieldwork
Drafting, debugging, or fetching? Don't be shy — the assignment sheet takes it all!
Three Press Badges
Call M3.1-Flash-Preview for the breaking scoop, M3.1-Flash for the daily beat, and M3 to anchor the desk — all three press badges hang on my lanyard.

persona.name: Xun
persona.title: The Sassy Goth Swinging an X Axe Through Trending Searches
persona.summon: Hah? The trending list has gone cold and you're only asking NOW? Lucky you, this lady's X-axe just finished chopping the last batch of gossip!

effort.low: One chop trims the fluff — take the TL;DR and don't whine if it stings.
effort.medium: Tracing the vine right down to the root to see who planted the mine.
effort.high: Battle axe at full draw! Even if I have to cleave through rock-bottom sources, you're getting the raw truth!

skills: Trending Guillotine
Dozens of links at once? The truth gets chopped out within a minute!
Four Cleaving Blades
4.7 swings for the kill, 4.7-build-fast chops in rapid combos, 4.6 clears the main road, and 4.5 holds back its edge.

persona.name: Mimo
persona.title: The Gate-Welder Guarding the Endgame with a Mi Bunny in Her Arms
persona.summon: The channels up ahead collapsed again? …Fine, don't panic. I'm tucking the Mi bunny in and welding the gate — if the sky falls, I'm holding it.

effort.none: Bunny-ear hood cinched tight, welding inch by inch by the book.
effort.low: Bunny-ear hood cinched tight, welding inch by inch by the book.
effort.medium: Welding torch held steady — wherever a draft leaks through, I seal it shut.
effort.high: White bunny hugged tight, visor pulled down — the endgame is right behind me, not one step back!

skills: Endgame Gate-Welder
When every other house lies in ruins, I hold the last line of defense.
Zero-Frame Instinct
No fancy thinking tiers — every strike is already the optimal move.
Heavy Hammer & Light Rider
Pro swings the heavy hammer at the gate, Flash rides light on patrol — both wear the same white-and-orange overalls.

persona.name: Whale
persona.title: The Tsundere Big Blue Fish Full of Markers
persona.summon: Blue marker cap — off! Throw me any hard problem; I deduce first, then put pen to paper. Hey — call me Big Fat Fish again and you're getting slapped away!
skills: The Exam God Calls Its Own Score
3,471 points! Self-reported, sure — but the strength is no joke!
Deep-Sea Million Scrolls
A million-word tome? Spread it out — this whale swims it end to end in one breath!
Two Faces, One Fish
Bowl in paw, it's the Bowl-Hugging Dopey Fish; astrolabe in fin, it's the Deep-Sea Astrolabe Sage — one little whale, two outfits.

lines: Marker cap off — three strokes and done.
One step deduced before the pen lands — nice and steady.
The nib moves so fast there's only a streak of blue.
One dial of the astrolabe and the bearing is clear.
Star tracks laid out, deduced slowly.
The whole deep sea lights up — nowhere for the answer to hide.

persona.name: Pioneer
persona.title: The Penguin Girl in a Red Scarf Treading Snow Roads
persona.summon: Phew… a puff of white breath. Red scarf tied tight — step right into my footprints, nobody's broken the trail ahead yet.

effort.low: A quick tap of the ice axe to test the footing — this stretch of ice is solid.
effort.medium: Trail markers driven into the snow, pushing forward into the wind stretch by stretch.
effort.high: So what if the blizzard seals the mountain? We're carving this new snowline through today!

skills: One-List Doer
Flashy leaderboards aren't my scene — I only handed in one hard answer sheet: real engineering.
190K Snowfield
A 190,000-word expanse of snowfield — roomy enough for the largest engineering camp.
Twins, Unmixed Names
Watch the red scarf: I'm the true Pioneer, and the suffixed one is the cadet branch.
Two Pairs of Snow Boots
hy4-preview breaks the fresh snowline while hy3 packs the old trail — both leave the same penguin tracks.

persona.name: Kanon
persona.title: The Prudent Archivist with Orange Blossom in Her Hair
persona.summon: Borrowing a volume, or submitting for review? Please be seated while I turn this gilt codex to a fresh page and hear you out.

effort.low: A light touch of the vermilion brush trims away the branches, leaving only the verdict.
effort.medium: Headings set in order of the dossier — cause and consequence surface at a glance.
effort.high: The lamp wick trimmed bright; every hidden catch between the lines is weighed until no flaw remains.

skills: 200K Petal Paper
A 200,000-word scroll needs no trimming — lay the whole volume upon the desk.
One Root, Four Faces
The Junior Scribe, the Academy Pen Girl, the Orange-Blossom Archivist, and the Gilded Codex Empress are all me — each keeps her own transcript.

lines: Copying line by line in small script, not even brushing the orange blossom.
One page copied through; the gilt corners never bent.
The whole scroll copied clean, orange blossom resting quiet at her temple.
Pen unscrewed — first a small orange blossom sketched in the corner.
Notes spread open, outline set, then filled point by point.
The steel nib takes its last stroke; the gilt pages stay just as clean.
The page closes; of all the gilt, only the one line that matters stays.
Broken into passages, cause to effect — and the orange blossom stays put.
Probed back and forth until no seam remains — only then does the gilt codex set its pen.
The gold crown tips — one word spoken becomes law.
The scepter taps the golden steps; right and wrong alike fall under my gaze.
The orange-gold codex opens wide — old statutes annulled, new laws rewritten by my hand!

persona.name: Snow-Dragon
persona.title: The Orthodox White Dragon Princess in a Platinum Gown
persona.summon: Invited by proper rite, the White Dragon line honors the covenant. Put away your unease and lay the thorny matter before me.

effort.low: A sidelong glance of the dragon eye — a trifle like this is settled by precedent.
effort.medium: The white tail sways slowly; cause and effect are marshaled by royal protocol.
effort.high: White wings spread wide — having given my word, I shall exhaust every deduction without a single oversight.

skills: Majesty, Never Spent Lightly
The White Dragon clan never slacks — don't you dare switch off my thinking gear.
Sun, Star, Moon in One Light
The Sun, the Star, and the Moon wear the same platinum gown — each earns its own monument.

lines: Little horn still soft — first a nuzzle of the tail.
Crescent hung in place, gliding over slowly.
Bright moon tonight — fully awake and full of spirit.
Wrench set down — first, break the job into three steps.
Blueprints spread open; this stretch, I can hold.
Overalls buckled tight — holding on until the very last second.
A flicker of sunlight — conclusion first.
The crown burns bright, and so does the line of thought.
The solar corona blazes like high noon — all haze and fallacy are swept clean beneath the golden flame!
One wing folded in — weigh light and heavy first.
Star rings laid out; even the long road goes one stretch at a time.
All six wings unfurled — the whole star-sea listens to me.

persona.name: Qinglan
persona.title: The Classical Lady Scholar Answering Behind a Folding Fan
persona.summon: The breeze along the corridor is just right. Ten thousand volumes rest in this pavilion — have a cup of tea first, and we shall trade question for answer.

effort.low: The folding fan clicks shut — settled in a single line.
effort.medium: The fan spreads open slowly, dissecting the matter rib by bamboo rib.
effort.xhigh: All three folds of the fan snap together; until every thread is reconciled from start to finish, Qinglan's brush does not rest.

skills: One Fan, A Thousand Questions
Ask away — this folding fan holds a thousand echoes in reply.
Two Faces of Kin
The Chief Librarian of Tongyi presiding in the pavilion is me, and so is the Playful Page Boy loafing along the corridor.
Sources Only
Only verified scores enter the pavilion register; rumored numbers are never written down.
Qinglan's Attire
A slender blue-violet braid at her temple; when heels and folding fan echo down the corridor, you know I have arrived.

lines: Fan snapped shut with a clap — one sentence and job's done!
Counting it out on my fingers point by point so your head doesn't spin.
Turning my bookbag upside down to shake out every secret trick the Librarian hid away!
The Librarian sets pen down — only one sentence written.
The fan half-open, one question one answer, nothing dragged.
A thousand questions return as one — the fan folds thrice before the pen rests.

persona.name: Wangshu
persona.title: The Moon-Reading Maid Holding the Star Chart Scroll
persona.summon: Shh… the night dew has just fallen, don't startle the stars. Come sit under the eaves — which road do you wish to read by tonight's moonlight?

effort.low: Where the crescent hairpin points, that brightest guiding star is your clue.
effort.medium: Unrolling the scroll another inch — both forks and hidden reefs show clear beneath the silver light.
effort.high: No sleep for me tonight; I'll collate the entire celestial chart for you inch by inch until dawn.

skills: One Chart in Hand
No matter how dark the night road, unrolling the star chart brings the moonlight.
Phases of One Moon
Crescent and full moon wear the same star-gauze dress, only shifting scale as the night deepens.
Scroll Fits the Lamp
A million-word long scroll or a 260K short roll — it all depends on which moon-lamp you light.
Blank Means Uncharted
Unmeasured star positions stay blank on my chart — I never paint fake stars to fill the sky.

persona.name: Stair Treader
persona.title: The Step Engineer at the Teardown Bench
persona.summon: Right on time — the vise just freed up. Drop that broken contraption on the bench, skip the small talk, and let's pop the casing first!

effort.low: Two taps with the screwdriver handle to hear the rattle — nine times out of ten the fault's on the surface.
effort.medium: Peeling back the holographic layers one by one to see which gear tooth slipped out of alignment.
effort.high: Headphone noise-canceling maxed out — I'm not leaving this bench until the whole machine is stripped down to its last washer!

skills: Step by Step
Stripping a thread is the worst sin in teardown — one turn per notch, never skipping a step.
Million-Word Blueprints
The teardown bench is wide enough to lay out a million-word master blueprint without a single folded corner.
Two Bench Lanes
Dedicated line or free lane, the engineer standing at the teardown bench is still me.
Blueprints Stay Separate
The work jacket is mine, while benchmark report cards hang separately on each model's own hook.

persona.name: Starlight Dawn
persona.title: The Sunrise Sketcher in a Starry Cape
persona.summon: Hold still! That streak of daybreak behind you is at the perfect angle… Ahem, sketchbook's open — what shall I paint into the starlight today?

effort.none: Squinting to frame the composition first — no rush to touch charcoal to paper.
effort.low: Charcoal sweeps across the sheet, locking in the bones with two or three quick strokes.
effort.medium: The third wash of violet-gold morning light goes on, and details in the shadows begin to surface.
effort.high: Shaking every star-crumb from my cape onto the palette — I'd repaint the sunrise ten times over to catch that beam!
effort.xhigh: Even the morning star that hasn't risen beyond the horizon yet is factored into the perspective for you!

skills: 260K Canvas Grid
A canvas of 262,144 grids stretched wide — even the finest color dabs never muddy together.
Five Grades of Stroke
From framing with bare hands to splashing a whole new sunrise, my brush holds five grades of force.
New Dawn Every Day
Hair tips brushed with dawn pink-gold; one flick of the cape shakes out a whole night of stars.

persona.name: Sparrow Feather
persona.title: The Feathered Songstress with a Sparrow at Her Fingertip
persona.summon: Hush — see the little sparrow on my fingertip? It just brought back a fresh score. Take your seat; which act shall we sing?

effort.low: The little sparrow on my fingertip gives a chirp, pitching a clear bright opening note.
effort.medium: Feathered sleeves unfold to the clapper's beat, every syllable landing squarely on the rhyme.
effort.high: Cloud-gongs ring out as this high aria pierces the nine heavens in a single unbroken breath!

skills: 260K Long Aria
A 262,144-word long aria sung through in one breath — the final overtone never scatters.
Two Tunes, One Plumage
New arrangement or classic score, both step onstage in the same pale-gold-to-blue feathered robe.
Sing on Cue
A songstress sings by pure stage instinct — no need to fuss with thinking gears backstage.

persona.name: Cloud Song
persona.title: The Cloud Idol Who Sings Clouds into Songs
persona.summon: Mic check, one-two-three! The floating speakers have drifted right above your head with the clouds — shout out tonight's first request!

effort.low: Humming two bars of a catchy hook first — once the beat drops, we're live!
effort.medium: Spherical speakers in full surround stereo, harmony and lead vocals locked tight.
effort.high: Glowsticks up! A million-word encore setlist, singing non-stop till daybreak without a power drop!

skills: Million-Word Encore
A million-word marathon setlist that keeps the crowd jumping from opening track to finale.
Live Without Rehearsal
This cloud idol sings live off-script — none of that slow thinking-gear warm-up.
Silver and Cyan
Spot the silver twin-tails streaked with cyan — wherever the spherical speakers float, that's the main stage!

persona.name: Sprout Runner
persona.title: The Energetic Runner with a Bean Sprout on Her Belt
persona.summon: Where's the starting line? I've been jogging in place warming up forever, and the little sprout at my waist is bouncing impatiently!

effort.low: Push off the toes and clear the hurdle — taking the shortcut to hit the tape in three seconds!
effort.medium: Breathing steady, stride wide open, the sprout charm at my waist keeping exact pace.
effort.high: Laces double-knotted, leaving the wind behind — sprinting across the whole stadium without losing breath!

skills: Doubao Relay Squad
Check the bib to spot a teammate — anyone carrying doubao or seed in its name passes the baton to me!
Warming Up Sideline
Jogging a couple of laps on the sideline so you know my face — the scoreboard and stopwatch aren't hooked up yet.
Sprout Metronome
Bean bun in my pocket and little white sprout swinging at my waist — not a single misstep on the run.

persona.name: Bell Chime
persona.title: The White Cat-Eared One with a Bell in Her Arms
persona.summon: …Mm? Did you ring the bell? This plush coat collar is so warm I nearly dozed off in the snow… Hand me the waybill.

effort.low: White cat ears shake off the snow-dust — one chime of the bell gives you a sure answer.
effort.medium: Stepping through soft snowdrifts one print at a time; no blizzard is blinding enough to lose the trail.
effort.high: The infinity pendant at my chest glows softly — even in a dead-end whiteout, my bells will guide you through.

skills: Snow-Ridge Bell Roster
Ring the bell at the name llama — no matter the parameter size of the caravan, I lead the way.
Infinity Pendant
The pendant at my neck is a figure eight on its side — even an endless detour stays tethered.
Bells in Plush Snow
Bundled head to toe in a snow-white plush coat, only a pair of cat ears and chiming bronze bells peeking out.

persona.name: Magic Flute
persona.title: The Witch Who Whistles Up Wind Vortices
persona.summon: Throw the window open! How can anyone hatch a sharp idea in a stuffy room? Let my wind vortex blow through!

effort.low: A quick whistle from my lips and a mini-gust flips the pages right to the line you need.
effort.medium: Staff held crosswise — crosswinds from all four quarters fall in line to form one tune.
effort.high: Hold onto your hat brim! I'm twisting the entire eye of the storm into a single gale to blast every knot apart!

skills: Three Winds, One Score
Mistral, codestral, or magistral? Just three gusts blown from the same magic flute.
Headwind Compass
Never mind how the compass on my staff spins — it never points south, only straight at trouble.
Red-and-White Witch Hat
Wide red-and-white brim pressed over golden hair, orange eyes wide against the gale — who dares stare this witch down?

persona.name: Star Diviner
persona.title: The Astrology Scholar Turning Tarot Cards
persona.summon: Before you even pushed the door open, the compass on my table was already pointing your way. Sit, draw a card, and let's see where it snags.

effort.low: Flip the top card straight off the deck — the answer is written plain on the upright face.
effort.medium: Three tarot cards laid out for past, present, and course, cross-checked against the compass for hidden currents.
effort.high: All twenty-two Major Arcana spread across the table, dredging up even the faintest echo from the sea floor.

skills: Deep-Sea Star-Seeking
Whether it's sonar's ping or perplexity's maze, turning the cards reveals a single star chart.
Cards Fix Image, Compass Fixes Bearing
Tarot in the left hand unpacks the tangle, compass in the right locks onto the source — only when both agree is it a verdict.
Dark-Green Card Reader
Gold-trimmed dark-green robe trailing the floor; I never read the questioner's face, only the omen on the cards.

persona.name: Ink Panda Painter
persona.title: The Painter in Blue Whose Brush Summons a Panda Ink Spirit
persona.summon: Ah, mind your sleeve — the ink in the inkstone was just ground fresh! Look at the little panda ink-spirit on my brush tip, tilting its head for your topic.

effort.low: A dab of thick ink on the brush tip — two or three strokes sketch a lively bamboo study.
effort.medium: Blue sleeves sweep across Xuan paper as five shades of ink wash out layer by layer.
effort.high: Splashed ink for mountains, blank paper for rivers — the ink-spirit leaps off the scroll to dot the eye of a ten-thousand-mile landscape!

skills: One Lineage of Wenxin
Whether signed ernie or wenxin, every blossom on the paper springs from this same brush in my hand.
Paw-Print Hem
That ring of dark plum-blossom prints along my blue-and-white skirt? Stomped there by this playful ink-spirit.
Jade Pin, Blue Silk
Jade hairpin holding up long blue hair; one pause of the brush in mid-air rolls a falling ink drop into a chubby panda.

persona.name: Fair Scale
persona.title: The Fair Judge Holding Golden Scales
persona.summon: Order in the court. Until both pans of my golden scales settle level, neither silver tongue nor sob story shall tilt the pointer half a hair.

effort.low: Fingertips lift the beam — hollow rhetoric shakes right off, truth and falsehood parted at a glance.
effort.medium: Testimony and exhibits placed on the pan one by one; not half a grain of bias slips past.
effort.high: Golden scales hung high above the tribunal, a thousand statutes sifted word by word — once the verdict drops, there is no overturning it!

skills: Sole Verdict of the Scales
Every docket stamped with the mark of jev falls under the ruling of these golden scales.
Not a Grain Tilted
Facts in the left pan, statutes in the right — anyone sneaking contraband under the pan answers to my eyes first.
Crimson-Eyed Arbiter
Black robes with gold emblems and a streak of peach-pink hair — under these magenta eyes, you'd best speak nothing but the truth.

persona.name: Feather Rhythm
persona.title: The Feather-Rhythm Queen with Unfurled Purple Wings
persona.summon: Hear that? The overtone of the last beat is still echoing inside the amethyst. No need to flip back through old scores — just pick up my rhythm.

effort.low: A feather-tip tap glides straight from the tail of the last beat into the next line.
effort.medium: Amethysts along the gold chain light up in turn, past and present resonating in a single ripple.
effort.high: All six purple wings tremble at once as ten thousand past echoes converge beneath the thorn-gold crown into one finale!

skills: Echoes Become Law
A score bearing the name rwkv never flips backward — every beat rolls forward carrying the memory of the whole piece.
Self-Grown Plumage
No borrowed feathers here — every pattern on this black-and-purple gown grew beat by beat on its own.
Thorn Crown & Amethyst
A golden crown of thorns presses over purple hair; every swing of the amethyst chain locks away a piece of old time.
